reference.title: Library row fields
reference.shortdesc: Each Library row summarizes identity, schema, note, validation state, lifecycle state, and update time for one saved profile.

section.title: Identity
section.p: The row name, ID, note, and update time help confirm that you are acting on the intended saved profile.

section.title: State
section.p: The schema channel, validation state, and lifecycle state explain which editor actions, lifecycle actions, and export-related actions are currently suitable.

section.title: Warning
section.p: Do not rely on row position alone after sorting or filtering. Confirm identity fields before duplicate, archive, restore, or permanent delete actions.

section.title: Recovery
section.p: If row information appears stale, refresh the Library before repeating the action.
